mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for September 23, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. Priests Against Genocide hold shroud with names of children killed in Gaza. Priests Against Genocide hold shroud with names of 300 children killed in 'ceasefires' in Gaza, the occupied West Bank. This was reported by Al Jazeera. 2. Netanyahu calls Macron's remarks on West Bank in UN speech 'grotesque'. Israel's PM denounces the French president after he appeared to downplay Hamas's activities in the occupied territory. This was reported by BBC News.
